_label: Bill consultation policy (DESIGN_2028 3.6, stories S-35 and S-36). Engineering defaults pending the same counsel and panel sign-off as docs/decisions. Read by server/civic/consultations (cached; restart to reload). A consultation is a signal, not a referendum.

panel.note: Same model as Pulse Surveys: two distinct reviewers approve the CURRENT content hash (EN and TE plain-language summaries included); never the creator or anyone in the creator's department. A correction is a new version that needs the same two approvals before it replaces the public one.

review_sample.note: Suggested human review sample: one representative per near-duplicate cluster plus a seeded random pick of the remaining comments. The closing report states how many comments were actually read.

disclaimer.en: A consultation is a signal, not a referendum. Each person counts once per clause.
disclaimer.te: ఈ సంప్రదింపు ప్రజల అభిప్రాయ సూచన మాత్రమే; ఇది ప్రజాభిప్రాయ నిర్ణయం కాదు. ప్రతి నిబంధనకు ఒక్కొక్కరిని ఒకసారి మాత్రమే లెక్కిస్తారు.
